title: 2025 NBA draft: The complete results from the first round on Wednesday - NewsBreak
text: The first round of the 2025 NBA draft is officially completed, with 30 prospects hearing their names called by Commissioner Adam Silver at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. Duke forward Cooper Flagg was the first player selected on Wednesday by the Dallas Mavericks , becoming the sixth Blue Devils player to be chosen with the No. 1 pick. He was the overwhelming favorite to be the top choice after establishing himself as the Player of the Year last season. With Flagg off the board, the San Antonio Spurs took Dylan Harper with the second pick and the Philadelphia 76ers chose VJ Edgecombe at No. 3. Kon Knueppel went to the Charlotte Hornets at No. 4, and Ace Bailey rounded out the top five to the Utah Jazz . While the top five went relatively to plan, the rest of the evening was filled with plenty of trades and surprising selections. The final results are expected to generate numerous reactions and conversations throughout the remainder of the week and the months to come. The 2025 NBA draft features a two-night format for the second consecutive year, with the second round scheduled for Thursday at the Barclays Center (8 p.m. EDT, ESPN).
